1.name: Event Plaza
1.desc:
The most popular area in the park.
If you're looking for a quick ride or good food, this is where you want to be.
There's a sign at the entrance with a warning on it: "There are invisible walls around. Please do not launch aircraft or drones in the park."

2.name: Fountain of Wishes
2.desc:
This fountain is rumored to grant every wish you make to it.
Heaps of golden coins line its bottom, each one a symbol of a wish made.
As you passed by, you heard someone wish for every day to be a holiday.
Unfortunately for them, such sloth won't be tolerated.

3.name: Dream Castle
3.desc:
A fantasy castle like something right out of a fairy tale, this building serves as the park's chief landmark.
It houses numerous dressing rooms as well as a large banquet hall.
Rumors say there are mysteries waiting inside. Take your invitation and go explore.

4.name: Water Area
4.desc:
Need to cool off, or just want to go on one of the many slides? The water area has you covered.
For safety reasons, access to the attractions is determined not by ship type, but by height.
A certain aircraft carrier filed a formal complaint about this.

5.name: Circus Stage
5.desc:
A fantastical stage hosting a new performance at every strike of the hour hand.
The current featured performance is: The Great Adventures of Z35 the Magical Girl.
Strange place to have an adventure in, but we digress...

6.name: Foggy Maze
6.desc:
A strange place brimming with mystery and shrouded in mist.
Overcome its many obstacles and trials, and its secrets will be revealed to you.
A sign at the entrance reads: "If you get lost, please don't start breaching the walls; instead reach out to a member of staff."
